reviewPassage:
Bring your rain barrel to the park workshop on Sunday for a free check. The workshop opens at ten. Empty the barrel before you leave home; it will be lighter to carry.

Use the gate by the basketball court. A volunteer at the gate will guide you to a numbered space. Please stay there until a technician calls that number. Let the technician know if you have noticed water leaking around the tap.

After the check, the technician will hand you a results card. Please clip that card to the barrel handle before you leave.
reviewPassageZh:
週日可以把雨水桶帶到公園的工作區免費檢查。活動工作區於上午十點開放。出門前請先將桶內的水倒掉，搬運時會比較輕。

請走籃球場旁的入口。入口的志工會引導你前往有編號的位置。請留在該處，等技師叫到該號碼。如果你注意到水龍頭附近有水漏出，請告訴技師。

檢查後，技師會交給你一張結果卡。離開前，請把那張卡片夾在水桶提把上。
